name: THE GRAND HOTEL
source:
Meg and Alice graduated this spring and they are best friends. 
They are trying to find job at the Luxury Hotel "Grand Hotel". The final exam is to pick up the debts from long-standing patrons.
However, all the patrons are weirdo. Will girls be able to adapt?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]

After our girls graduate, they want to work in the Grand Hotel. During their interview, they are told there is a test before they get hired. They have to collect over due money from some people. They are going to have hard and fun times doing that. Maybe working for this hotel is not so grand.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
梅格和爱丽丝今年春天刚刚毕业，两人是最要好的朋友。她们正在争取进入豪华酒店“格兰德大酒店”工作。最后一项考核，是向几名老主顾追讨欠款。然而，这些客人个个都是怪人。两名女孩能够适应吗？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]

女孩们毕业后，打算到格兰德大酒店工作。面试时，她们得知受聘前还要通过一项测试：向几名欠款逾期的人讨债。这趟差事注定既艰辛又热闹。也许，为这家“大酒店”工作并没有听起来那么气派。

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
